data.body: [P2] Track only actions that actually reached the phase gate. This treats every unused `AfterInvocationCompleted` action as pending, even when no matching `CallbackStarted` event appeared. Consequently, history-only validation cannot return after its expected events match, and a terminal execution gains a spurious delivery error, unlike ordinary unused actions. Add an action to a deferred set only after it matches a callback but lacks a later `InvocationCompleted`, clear it after delivery, and use that set for both pending checks; include an unmatched-action regression test.
